objective: Execute an evidence-backed audit of the declared P1-P6 Astronomical Data Analysis & Discovery Platform scope before release freeze.

validation.acceptance: All selected contract/integration tests and declared product-surface checks pass.

lessons: Repository code presence is not sufficient for stage completion; the declared product surfaces require explicit executable audit evidence.
prevention_rules: Do not mark P1-P6 complete from implementation inspection alone.
Require a reproducible audit workflow and retained evidence artifact before release freeze.
next_stage: If PASS: final release-scope audit, freeze, and v1.0 evidence bundle. If FAIL: fix evidenced defects and rerun.
